runway_gen4_5.label: Runway Gen-4.5
runway_gen4_5.template: [Camera: {camera} | Framing: {framing}] {style} style video showing {action}. Set in {environment}. {lighting} Duration: {duration}s. {negative}
runway_gen4_5.notes: Camera direction must come first. Keep prompts concise. No negative prompt support.

google_veo3_1.label: Google Veo 3.1
google_veo3_1.template: {style}. {lighting}. A {duration}-second clip showing {action} in {environment}. Camera: {camera}, framed as {framing}. {color_grading}. {negative}
google_veo3_1.notes: Thrives on environment physics, color grading, and realistic scene details. Supports negative prompts.

kling_3_0.label: Kling 3.0
kling_3_0.template: {action}, captured via {camera} in {framing}. Location: {environment}. Style: {style}. Atmosphere: {lighting}. Duration: {duration}s. Color: {color_grading}. {negative}
kling_3_0.notes: Responds well to fluid action sequences, motion pacing terms, and atmospheric composition.

sora_2.label: OpenAI Sora 2
sora_2.template: A {duration}-second video in {style}. {action}. The scene is set in {environment}, captured with {camera} and {framing}. Lighting: {lighting}. Color grading: {color_grading}. {negative}
sora_2.notes: Prefers natural language descriptions. Strong at physics simulation and complex motion.

luma_dream_machine.label: Luma Dream Machine
luma_dream_machine.notes: Short clips only. Strong at realistic motion. Keep prompts under 200 characters for best results.

pika_2.label: Pika 2.0
pika_2.notes: Uses --no flag for negatives. Short duration. Good for stylized and animated content.

haiper_2.label: Haiper 2.0
haiper_2.template: {style} footage lasting {duration}s. {action} within {environment}. Camera uses {camera} with {framing}. {lighting}. {color_grading}. {negative}
haiper_2.notes: Very short clips. Strong at photorealistic content. No negative prompt support.

stable_video_diffusion.label: Stable Video Diffusion
stable_video_diffusion.notes: Very short clips. Comma-separated format works best. Strong negative prompt support.
